question: What function is assigned to the wind-filling air with respect to its presence in all beings?
premises: There is an air described as wind-filling.
That air is present in all beings.
In that context it is described as situated.
inference: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
uncertainties: The mode of its situatedness is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The wind-filling air is situated in all beings.
